# memex

> Local-first second brain for Claude. Notes stored as plain Markdown, indexed with a local multilingual embedding model, exposed to Claude over MCP. Fully offline, no API keys.

memex makes Claude smarter about you. It searches your notes before answering and saves insights at the end of every conversation — automatically. Hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 + tag) over an `~/.memex/memex.db` SQLite database with `sqlite-vec`. Multilingual (Korean + English) via `multilingual-e5-base`. Obsidian-compatible: notes live as `.md` files in a vault you can also open in Obsidian.
